statement: The 150 historical source field declarations and 16 conditional syntax branches have been independently rechecked; these operational discrepancies prevent any statement of complete 150-field business parity. All risks below are evidence-backed gaps or differing safety policies, not proof the new ERP is faulty in production. Two of the eleven now have synthetic-only source-ledger implementations; they remain OPEN until full signed real-core integration and Owner approval. A separate no-write eight-intent Stock/Money port handoff preview now binds synthetic source IDs and independent candidate roles, while continuing to refuse all server authorization claims and ERP posting. The two source-book flows now also generate signed-context-SHAPED, authorization-disabled posting proposals, with finance balancing and replay diagnostics. They are NOT server-authorized, cryptographically signed, persisted or Owner accepted.
scope_limit: First 150 source candidates from original 1160 not individually mapped; 1010 remain for first pass. 86 previously critical-linked keys and source 20 obligations separately tracked.

gaps.finding: Original field label explicitly permits blank = cash; prototype requires explicit payMode. This is deliberate stricter control, not exact old data-entry parity.

Original source triggers yellow no_receipt plus red missing reason when appropriate; candidate blocks an expense without receipt even if reason is supplied. This is a safety restriction, not exact old warning severity parity.
gaps.source_fragment: Reason if a receipt is missing

gaps.finding: Source account list/visibility depends on old e.moneySrc capabilities. Candidate demo references an account ID but no signed tenant-scoped money account authorization or source option fallback is implemented.
Independent denomination sender/hub recount and explanation have synthetic evidence gates, but physical cash custody, timing, serial and signed ledger back-reference remain only paper drafts.

Frozen W-02 crates_sent/back/due and trays_sent/back/due are old entry fields. A new isolated synthetic-only event ledger now reconciles signed-reference opening, issues and partial returns against those independently entered due values, but an approved real returnable-container book, source policy, physical signatures and tenant-verified ERP persistence are still unbuilt.
